user_authorization: 同步进行: screen the four recommended local models and diagnose grasp/lift/hold failures concurrently.
models: allenai/Molmo2-4B BF16, INT8 only if resource constrained
inputs: 320x240 synchronized RGB plus aligned depth; normalized_1000 external contract; physical 3D comes from depth, never model-estimated metric coordinates.
selection: Development scene screens only; freeze final adapters, then allocate NEW independent scenes. Do not relabel reused development or historical held-out scenes as independent.
resource_policy: Downloads, CPU adapters and CPU MuJoCo diagnostics parallel; GPU inference leases granted serially by root.
network_policy: Model downloads/dependencies use enp7s0, explicit AliDNS, TLS and fixed upstream revisions/SHA; existing direct transport reused.
controller_policy: Reproduce same T5 cases with independent physical scoring; no relaxed safety or success thresholds, no GT in online path. Repairs and counterfactuals remain in isolated physics/workspace until reviewed.
comparability: Initial new-model comparison uses immutable source-snapshot. Controller variant cannot contaminate original comparison; any combined validation is separately versioned.
